name: datum-data-products
description: Groundwork for Datum data products on lake tables, for any data: the namespace, the owner space in the data scope, the lake credential, the catalog's columns and partitions, where the data's meaning is already written down (knowledge bases, other products, Ossie/Cube/dbt models, pipelines, teams), and the pitfalls data lakes share. Companion of the data-products skill of the datum plugin.
